newsitem.title: USA: Automatic Data to buy HealthPlan shares. [corrected 16:25 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Automatic Data to buy HealthPlan shares. [corrected 16:25 gmt]

text.p: Automatic Data Processing Inc has agreed to buy 1.3 million HealthPlan Services Inc shares from Noel Group Inc for $20 each, Automatic Data and Noel said on Wednesday.
After the deal is completed and HealthPlan completes its acquisition of Health Risk Management Inc, Noel Group will own about 26 percent of HealthPlan's common stock.
(Corrects name of company which will own the 26 pct of shares from Automatic Data)
Noel also agreed not to transfer its remaining shares in HealthPlan Services before September 30, 1997, apart from a distribution to shareholders, Automatic Data said.
Automatic Data said it would not acquire additional shares of HealthPlan Services without approval of the HealthPlan board of directors.
HealthPlan shares closed up 1-3/4 at 20-7/8 on trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
